$comment: Canonical plan definitions for Workspace Digital.
Single source of truth: src/lib/db/repositories/platform.ts reads this file to answer plan
questions and to keep the `plans` table in sync, and scripts/seed.mjs upserts the same rows.
The pricing page, the dashboard billing page and the API limits all come from here, so they
Limits are per calendar month unless noted. Where the pricing page and the enforcement code
previously disagreed, the LOWER limit won: the public page must never promise more than the
API enforces (Professional advertised 25 users while the API allowed 15, and Business
advertised 200 users while the API allowed 60).
Prices are in US dollars (cents) — the platform bills in USD; the currency a workspace
operates in is separate and stored per business.
